browser.role: provisional same-device comparator; not canonical Representative Device evidence

rtx2070_maxq.role: historical physical reference; not canonical four-class commodity vector

specialist_component_sensitivities.boundary: Memory-component values are not whole-miner energy and must not be divided into commodity whole-system values to claim specialized advantage.

throughput_sensitivity.boundary: The latency-only ceiling ignores compute, bandwidth, random-access efficiency under load, power and economics; it is not achieved throughput.

conclusion: Existing evidence is directionally adverse to assuming commodity energy/throughput parity, but insufficient for a valid specialist-vs-commodity economic ratio.
